name: Unrestricted LP333 prescribed pq2-compression annealing
hypothesis: A deterministic exact-integer local search that preserves the new pq2-compression seed [1,11,-11], [1,-11,11] may reach zero combined PAF residual and produce an unrestricted Legendre pair of length 333.
evidence_unit: one 7200-second deterministic multistart run at seed 20260727, with 2000000 proposals per restart, exact same-residue swaps, and promotion only at independently verified zero full-length residual
claim_boundary: The pq2-uncompression statement is a conjectural search lever, not a theorem. Only a serialized pair with binary domain, exact prescribed compression, row sums one, and independently recomputed combined PAF minus two at all 332 nonzero shifts is a mathematical candidate.

baseline.evidence: Pinned source 7aa7e3652bb92920972a7d2828cb65b152c45e2c8090b76f3203150ab18c8032 and seed 20260727 before any local-search proposal.
baseline.measurement: The deterministic exact-margin initial state has squared residual objective 130304, L1 residual 3864, and maximum absolute residual 64.

intervention.one_change: Apply the Kotsireas-Gallardo-Cava-Gomez-Gomez-Perez pq2-compression search lever to unrestricted length 333: initialize the six exact residue-class margins, propose only opposite-sign swaps within one residue class modulo 3, score all 166 independent exact integer PAF residuals, and use the frozen geometric annealing/restart schedule.
forbidden_confounds: floating-point PSD acceptance as a candidate
temperature tuning after observing the run
restart-length tuning after observing the run
claiming a nonzero score as a Legendre pair

controls.name: paper-to-levers-boundary
controls.purpose: Separate the published structured search conjecture from a proof of existence.
controls.expected: The experiment adopts only the prescribed pq2 compression mechanism from DOI 10.1016/j.jsc.2026.102606 and transfers no general existence or runtime claim.

controls.name: exact-margin-derivation
controls.expected: Since 333=3*11^2, the compressed rows are [1,11,-11] and [1,-11,11], equivalent to negative counts [55,50,61] and [55,61,50] in the three size-111 residue classes.

controls.name: incremental-delta-self-test
controls.purpose: Detect an incorrect O(333) PAF update.
controls.expected: For 2000 deterministic random same-residue swaps, every predicted PAF and squared objective equals a fresh O(333^2) recomputation and every exact margin remains unchanged.

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute all mathematical quantities without importing the C search implementation.
controls.expected: A separate Python bit-rotation auditor recomputes both 333-entry PAF vectors, all six margins, row sums, objective, L1 and maximum residual, and exact candidate status.

controls.name: mutation-control
controls.purpose: Ensure the final verifier is sensitive inside the prescribed slice.
controls.expected: An opposite-sign same-residue swap preserves the compression but is rejected by at least one full PAF equation.

controls.name: source-and-binary-pin
controls.expected: Source SHA-256 is 7aa7e3652bb92920972a7d2828cb65b152c45e2c8090b76f3203150ab18c8032 and compiled binary SHA-256 is a8854ad15a2d6c034a8a407eee12f32a0c8fda214660e41e99119b63980e8fd9.

primary_metric.name: exact squared combined PAF residual over shifts 1 through 166

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is exactly zero and the independent full result audit verifies both row sums, prescribed compression, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen 7200-second schedule completes with a valid independently audited nonzero best residual.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before it writes and audits its best state.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any compression derivation, incremental delta, source pin, binary pin, stored-score, full PAF, candidate-status, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Execute source SHA 7aa7e3652bb92920972a7d2828cb65b152c45e2c8090b76f3203150ab18c8032 and binary SHA a8854ad15a2d6c034a8a407eee12f32a0c8fda214660e41e99119b63980e8fd9 only.
Run seed 20260727, 2000000 proposals per restart, and the compiled temperature schedule without changes.
Stop immediately if the exact squared residual reaches zero.
Otherwise stop at 7200 wall seconds without another seed or cap extension.
Do not claim a candidate until the separate auditor passes all 332 nonzero shifts.
Do not tune from intermediate best scores.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, perform a second independent Legendre-pair audit, construct H668, verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, then package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the exact score trajectory and best pair, then use its residual structure to define a distinct preregistered repair mechanism rather than another seed.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the partial logs and rerun only the remaining frozen time if the interruption is external and reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest arithmetic, incremental-update, serialization, or binding control before any new target run.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned repositories, and public primary literature are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
